item.title: Trump Reveals Plan To Secure Third Term By Speaking For 7 Straight Years
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. — President Trump has unveiled his clever plan to secure a third term by simply continuing his State of the Union speech for the next seven years.

item.title: Democrats Refuse To Stand As Trump Introduces Jesus
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. — In a night where lawmakers raised eyebrows by remaining glued to their seats throughout the president's State of the Union address, analysts later said the most shocking incident of the night was when Democrats refused to stand as Trump introduced Jesus.

item.title: Devastating: Black New Yorkers Unable To Shovel Driveways As None Of Them Have ID
item.description: NEW YORK CITY — With winter storms pounding the Northeast, black New Yorkers were sadly left unable to shovel their driveways as none of them have a government ID.

item.title: Toddler Review: The Full Genius Of Despicable Me 3 Really Reveals Itself On The 27th Viewing
item.description: Critics rightfully question the depth of modern cinema, yet among the shallows we find a full-throated answer to their query in the towering form of Despicable Me 3. On my 27th viewing, I am only just beginning to peel back the sophisticated layers of this cinematic masterpiece.

item.title: Trump Forced To Deploy ICE During State Of The Union To Pepper Spray Unruly Democrats
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. — In a historic first, a sitting U.S. president was forced to subdue members of Congress with a squad of ICE agents, who pepper sprayed unruly Democrats as President Trump delivered his State of the Union address.
